scientific_question: How do already-known A/B/M constraints alter shared-reference environmental geometry and geographic G components across the frozen heterogeneous BAM finite worlds?
historical_boundary: Not a new independent simulation, ecological observation, confirmatory test, prediction endpoint, or causal attribution.

source_roster.method: for spec in SYSTEM_SPECS: build_generality_system(spec); audit_system_activation(system)

reference.features: landscape.environment, two raw variables, original row order tied to node_ids
reference.scaling: eog.comparative.fit_robust_reference on all candidate landscape nodes, once per system
reference.declaration: pooled-descriptive, retrospective, comparison groups included, not outcome-informed

geometry.primary_metric: 0.90 quantile of strictly positive pairwise Euclidean distances in frozen standardized feature coordinates (span)
supplemental_metrics: mean distance to centroid as a basic comparator

matched_comparison.sampling: deterministic without replacement within mask, independently seeded by system_id, bits, matched size; same mask+matched n gives same draw
matched_comparison.contrast: log(span_G / median(span_comparator draws)); non-estimable if fewer than 2 G nodes or zero span
matched_comparison.uncertainty: 5th/95th draw quantiles describe subsampling sensitivity only, never population confidence intervals

geographic_topology.grid: spec.height x spec.width; require exact one-to-one r{row}c{col} ID, coordinate (col,row), row-major order
geographic_topology.support_field: constant 1 on every declared node, 0 after known-mask gating; NOT a fitted SDM
geographic_topology.anchors: all positive G cells (ideal complete occurrence) declared before scoring, never candidates outside G
geographic_topology.interpretation: binary spatial component count, not dispersal or biological population persistence
geographic_topology.comparison: geographic G components vs environmental MST-cut components; their equality is not assumed

outputs.per_system: n worlds, n G-estimable, distinct occupied G masks, same-G mechanism aliases, median matched G/U and G/A log span ratios, environmental-vs-geographic component disagreement
outputs.overall: sum over fixed 12 systems; per-system results retained; no row-level pooled independent-sample inference
outputs.secondary: ratio directions by baseline; exact alias and fingerprint audit; other baselines and geometry outputs
integrity: same G produces same G geometry and geographic component count
outputs.artifact: CSV/JSON generated by action then result receipt pinned after scoring

forbidden_claims: The experimental descriptive contrasts are new independent ecological observations
EOG reconstructs the true A/B/M from occurrence geometry
Geographic components are realized dispersal pathways
MST or span is a causal decomposition of A/B/M
Sampled virtual worlds are independent natural ecological replicates
Post-exposure geometry contrasts validate any frozen EOG-WF outcome
